# InstaPlaque

> Personalised engraved brass and stainless steel plaques, made in the UK. Design a plaque online with a free proof and live prices, or send us your wording, a photo or an AI design on WhatsApp and we design it for you. Engraving, standard fixings and UK delivery are included in standard prices.

## Plaques

- [Memorial plaques](https://instaplaque.co.uk/memorial-plaques): engraved memorial plaques for walls, gardens and benches, from £95.50 (A5 stainless steel)
- [Bench plaques](https://instaplaque.co.uk/bench-plaques): memorial bench plaques from £58.50 (150 × 50 mm)
- [Brass plaques](https://instaplaque.co.uk/brass-plaques): brushed, polished, aged and orbital brass
- [Stainless steel plaques](https://instaplaque.co.uk/stainless-steel-plaques): brushed and polished stainless steel
- [Garden plaques](https://instaplaque.co.uk/garden-plaques): dedications for gardens, trees and planted spaces
- [Opening plaques](https://instaplaque.co.uk/opening-plaques): formal plaques for buildings, schools and community spaces
- [Custom plaques](https://instaplaque.co.uk/custom-plaques): custom sizes and shapes, including house signs
- [Portrait plaques](https://instaplaque.co.uk/portrait-plaques): people and pets engraved from a photo using our Portraits in Metal technology, with a free portrait sketch
- [AI design to plaque](https://instaplaque.co.uk/ai-plaque-design): send a plaque design made in ChatGPT or another AI tool and we redraw it for engraving, with a dimensioned proof PDF

## Ordering

- [Online plaque designer](https://instaplaque.co.uk/design): free, no account needed, live price and a downloadable proof
- [Have us design it](https://instaplaque.co.uk/design-request): send your wording and preferences; we email a proof to approve before payment
- [Sample proof PDF](https://instaplaque.co.uk/samples/instaplaque-sample-proof.pdf): what a designer-made proof looks like, with dimensions, fixings and fitting steps
- [How it works](https://instaplaque.co.uk/how-it-works): proofs, production times and UK delivery
- [Questions and answers](https://instaplaque.co.uk/faq)
- [Contact](https://instaplaque.co.uk/contact): WhatsApp 07464 843841, hello@instaplaque.co.uk
